claims.claim: UMN Extension suggests roughly 1/3–1/2 plant-based compost and 1/2–2/3 topsoil for raised beds.
claims.interpretation: Domain-specific implementation premise; jurisdiction and product variations acknowledged

claims.claim: Volumes assume fully rectangular uniform depth, settled geometry and user-entered compost ratio; monitor soil tests, phosphorus and salts. Bulk yards and bags vary by compaction/settling.

assumptions: Volumes assume fully rectangular uniform depth, settled geometry and user-entered compost ratio; monitor soil tests, phosphorus and salts. Bulk yards and bags vary by compaction/settling.
